notes.purpose: The pregnancy sweep: sows grouped by pen; lens To check / Checked / All, with an outcome sub-lens under Checked.

elements.name: Task row
elements.shows: one sow (or litter): tag, one fact line, one memory line, rail

states.when: an earlier unclear result is due again
states.shows: Recheck · due today, line 2 "unclear Jul 5 · G.H"
Pregnant · Jul 8 with stamp and edit pencil
Not pregnant · Jul 8 with stamp and edit pencil

elements.logic: Line 1 is words (state + when), line 2 is tokens (history, stamps). A chip appears only for an escalated measurement or a flagged observation; stamps appear on done rows and on rows that descend from a record. Everything on the row is derived; the worker types nothing here.

elements.name: Lens row
elements.shows: To check / Checked / All, funnel at the end
elements.logic: Checked has a sub-lens by outcome: pregnant, unclear, not pregnant. On the map the three outcomes collapse to "checked"; the split is the row list's.

elements.name: Unit KPI and Task overview
elements.shows: 95% pregnant, target 90 or more; Task overview "100/200 checked", day n of 3
elements.logic: Time-boxed task: day n of N under the overview. Pregnancy rate is derived; the docs state no formula.

rules: Bulk marking on all three outcomes is a confirmed product decision: the checker reads several sows in a row and marks them together (archive screens section 01).
Unclear schedules a recheck, 3 days by default (research D1).
issues: Pre-Astra look: box rows, header and dock predate the Astra task skeleton.

notes.purpose: The sheet behind the Task overview cell for pregnancy check: whole-task progress, KPI, configuration, SOP link and, where the task has one, End task. What failed the "does this change what a hand does at the pen right now?" test lives here, one tap from the room.

elements.name: End task
elements.shows: Red button at the bottom of the sheet.
elements.rule: Pregnancy check is a sweep task: End task shows always. The research adds an end summary of consequence tallies: pregnant follows the batch to farrowing, unclear stays as a scheduled recheck, not pregnant leaves the batch for rebreed (research D4).

elements.name: Configuration
elements.logic: This sweep is the 2nd check, day 20 after mating, window 3 days. The research config also lists a 1st check at day 10, a 3-day recheck and a target of 90 or more; whether two rounds is fixed or configurable is open (research Q4).

issues: Pre-Astra look: header, KPI cells and sheet styling predate the Astra task skeleton.

notes.purpose: The unit as a map: is there work here, how much, how urgent. Tap lands in the pen; it never acts.

elements.name: Pen cell
elements.shows: pen code and at most one chip. For pregnancy check, chips such as "2 late" and "5 check"; done pens read "checked".

states.when: signs, due today, long interval, needs check

states.shows: tick beside the code, outcome in muted text

states.when: no pigs of this task in the pen

elements.logic: Priority is fixed: red, amber, green, neutral, done, grey; one chip per cell, most urgent wins. Counts lead the word and appear only from 2. The picker never inherits the lens or filter: every pen shows its real state.
elements.rule: Tap = land (header pinned). Long-press shows the peek. The grid never acts.

notes.purpose: The pregnancy check recorded from a sow's own record: tap the Pregnancy check card under Current tasks on her record.
states: Opens with no outcome chosen; Save is disabled and says "Choose an outcome".

elements.name: Outcome options
elements.shows: the three results, each with its consequence on the option

states.shows: Keep in the current gestation batch
Close this task and return the sow to rebreed watch
Keep the task open for another check

elements.rule: One outcome per sow. The note is optional.

issues: The earlier list design names the outcomes Pregnant / Unclear / Not pregnant and gives Unclear a default 3-day recheck; this sheet says Recheck later and has no interval.
